vulncheck-cwp-preauth-module-dispatch-rc.scenarioName: VulnCheck — Control Web Panel (CWP) Pre-Auth Module Dispatch to Root RCE (CVE-2026-73695..104080)
vulncheck-cwp-preauth-module-dispatch-rc.summary: Disclosed by VulnCheck on November 3, 2026 ("Control Web Panel: Pre-Auth Module Dispatch to Root RCE"), this 10-CVE vulnerability chain demonstrates how a single missing exit() after header("Location: ...") in CWP User Panel port 2083 (CVE-2026-73696) combined with unvalidated module dispatch (CVE-2026-73695) exposes 170+ post-auth user modules to unauthenticated callers, enabling instant hosting-user RCE (CVE-2026-73697 / CVE-2026-77876) and single-request privilege escalation to root (uid=0) via the loopback User API on 127.0.0.1:2302 (CVE-2026-77877, CVE-2026-77878, CVE-2026-77879, CVE-2026-77880, CVE-2026-77881, CVE-2026-104080).
vulncheck-cwp-preauth-module-dispatch-rc.multiSourceSynthesis: Cross-vendor synthesis: VulnCheck Initial Access Intelligence discovered all 10 CVEs and unpacked the IonCube-protected builds (patches 1.8 through 1.30) to document the two-stage pre-auth-to-root architecture; Control Web Panel release notes confirm the September–November 2026 patch series; and CISA KEV / NVD records for prior CVE-2025-48703 illustrate why partial point-fixes in shared module dispatchers fail without structural authentication gates.

cves.status: VulnCheck CNA Disclosed · Patched in 1.16
cves.description: Pre-auth arbitrary file write (acc=update) and command injection (acc=addlabelphpiniadv rm -f) in modules/phpini_editor.php plus sed -i command injection (acc=deletedp) in modules/protected_directory.php.

cves.status: VulnCheck CNA Disclosed · Patched in 1.29 / 1.30
cves.description: Missing authentication on Loopback User API (127.0.0.1:2302) and root (uid=0) command injection in BackupHandler::restoreDBBackup() (/v1/restoredatabase/) and /valid_token/.

cves.status: VulnCheck CNA Disclosed · Patched in 1.16 / 1.27
cves.description: UNION SELECT SQLi auth bypass in access_token() as root@localhost, root command injection in /v1/newpass/ (/usr/bin/passwd), and time-based blind SQLi in /user_panel_dashboard/.
